clauses.text:
Executive Order No. 6247, of August 10, 1933, is hereby amended by the addi-
tion of a paragraph reading as follows:

“6. This Executive order shall not be construed to apply to such orders as the
President may issue approving codes of fair competition under title I of the National
Industrial Recovery Act (Public, No. 67, 73d Cong.).”

FRANKLIN D. ROOSEVELT.
THe Waite Hovss,

December 15, 1933.

[No. 6497]

U.S. GOVERNMENT PRINTING OFFICE: 1938
